overview.title: Mill Creek FFL at a glance
overview.description: How the league is organized, what defines the current season, and where to find its records.

paragraphs: 2026 is the active Mill Creek season, played on Sleeper as a 12-team keeper league.

format.title: League Format
bullets: Up to 3 keepers at their draft round

paragraphs: Mill Creek has continuous league history since 2014. Game-by-game records begin with the 2022 Sleeper season.
Every completed season from 2014 through 2025 is archived, with champions and franchise history kept.

story.title: Our Story: Mill Creek
story.teaser: Mill Creek FFL began in 2014 as a twelve-team keeper league for coworkers at the old mill offices.
